title: The Kyoto Card Shop Whose First Year No One Can Prove
conflicts: Founding year: Nintendo and most histories say 1889; playing-card researcher Marcus Richert (TechRadar) found Taisho/early Showa directories giving 1892 and no record of Fusajiro before 1895. The story gives both, attributed, without deciding. Founder's age in 1889 differs (Richert implies 21; a 1859 birth year implies about 30), so no age is given. Legalisation year (1885) is attributed to one account. Company scale uses the conservative 'one of Japan's largest'.
notes: No first-hand account by Yamauchi exists, so the story is built around what the record does and does not show; motives are attributed to historians Florent Gorges and Alexander Smith as quoted by Film Stories/Wireframe. Omitted the cement-company background and the Japan Tobacco distribution legend as not reliably sourced.
